# VK Icons assets used by OrkanSlicer Nightly

The selected Android VectorDrawable assets under `app/src/main/res/drawable/vk_*` are generated from the official VK Icons dataset used by https://ytkab0bp.ru/vkicons/ and sourced from https://github.com/VKCOM/icons (master). They are used for workspace navigation and common model actions. The upstream collection is licensed under MIT; see `third_party/licenses/VKCOM-icons-LICENSE.txt`.
